Prompted by the Breast Cancer Awareness Month, IASO offers the necessary screening tests at special preferential prices. Specifically it offers: Digital Mammography at the special preferential price of 40€. Digital Mammography & Tomosynthesis at the special preferential price of 45€. Digital Mammography & Breast Ultrasound at the special preferential price 50€. Digital Mammography & Tomosynthesis and Breast Ultrasound at the special preferential price of 65€.
